sources.title: π0 openpi — Open Vision-Language-Action Robot Model | FreeAPIHub
sources.snippet: π0 is an open vision-language-action model for robots — it takes camera images and a written instruction and outputs motor actions. Pretrained on more than 10,000 hours of robot data, Apache 2.0, and it runs inference on a single RTX 4090.
